title: Question 29
passage:
Did that price print on its own, or did someone add it by hand?
A. I can check whether the price includes tax. B. That’s my handwriting. The printer left that line blank. C. I printed another copy after lunch.
passageZh:
那個價格是自動印出來的，還是有人手寫補上去的？
A. 我可以確認這個價格含不含稅。 B. 那是我的筆跡。印表機印出來時，那一行是空白的。 C. 我午餐後又印了一份。
